seeds.title: Recognition of the Component Odors in Mixtures
seeds.intended_methodological_use: Constrain component-recognition, suppression, and selective-adaptation hypotheses.

seeds.title: Mixture and Concentration Effects on Odorant Receptor Response Patterns In Vivo
seeds.intended_methodological_use: Constrain concentration, mixture-interaction, and receptor-to-perception uncertainty.
seeds.identity_note: The DOI resolves to McClintock et al.; an earlier planning note incorrectly attributed it to Zak et al.

seeds.title: Temporal dominance of sensations and sensory profiling: A comparative study
seeds.intended_methodological_use: Inform temporal endpoint and dominance-profile design while preserving product-domain limits.

seeds.title: Human olfactory perception embeds fine temporal resolution within a single sniff
seeds.intended_methodological_use: Permit within-sniff questions only with a qualified sniff-triggered apparatus and protocol.

seeds.title: The perception of odor pleasantness is shared across cultures
seeds.intended_methodological_use: Require both population scope and individual-heterogeneity reporting for pleasantness.

seeds.title: Assessment of odor hedonic perception: the Sniffin' sticks parosmia test (SSParoT)
seeds.intended_methodological_use: Inform pairwise hedonic assessment, separate intensity ratings, and test-retest requirements.

seeds.title: What is a mixture design?
seeds.intended_methodological_use: Require constrained proportions, explicit response variables, and adequate mixture designs.

seeds.title: Sensory analysis — Selection and training of sensory assessors
seeds.intended_methodological_use: Public metadata only: define assessor selection and training scope.

seeds.title: Sensory analysis — Methodology — General guidance for establishing a sensory profile
seeds.intended_methodological_use: Public metadata only: define descriptive-profile methodology scope.

seeds.title: Sensory analysis — Methodology — General guidance for conducting hedonic tests with consumers in a controlled area
seeds.intended_methodological_use: Public metadata only: keep controlled consumer liking separate from trained-panel description.

seeds.title: On a Measure of the Information Provided by an Experiment
seeds.intended_methodological_use: Constrain claims of expected information: Bayesian information gain requires a prior distribution and a predictive experiment model; when those are absent, do not invent outcome probabilities.

seeds.title: Bayesian Experimental Design: A Review
seeds.intended_methodological_use: Constrain experimental utility to a declared decision problem, prior, likelihood, and utility; prevent an unsupported composite hedonic utility from being smuggled into experiment ranking.

seeds.title: The Design of Experiments for Discriminating Between Two Rival Models
seeds.intended_methodological_use: Support explicit model-discrimination experiments while preserving the transfer limit from regression-model design to finite predeclared perfume hypotheses.
